stdout:
Usage:
  pnpm signals:analyze -- --asset example.com [options]

Options:
  --asset <id>        required property id
  --in <directory>    default .local/signal-dumps/downloads/<asset>
  --out <directory>   default .local/signal-dumps/analysis/<asset>
  --reclamation-targets <path>
                      this property's OPEN outreach targets, as
                      pnpm reclamation:open-targets writes them. When
                      absent the reclamation rule stays silent.
